comment: Registry of AMD-maintained and community llama.cpp forks for nightly perf regression tracking. Add new forks by appending entries — no code changes needed. binary_url uses {version} as a placeholder substituted at runtime from the latest GitHub release tag.

forks.label: llama.cpp ROCm Nightly (lemonade-sdk)
forks.notes: Lemonade nightly ROCm channel. Built via TheRock SDK. Not upstreamed.

forks.label: llama.cpp ROCm Stable (lemonade-sdk)
forks.notes: Lemonade stable ROCm channel. Not upstreamed.

forks.label: llama.cpp gfx11 (AMD-Ecosystem)
forks.notes: Nightly dated builds. Tag format: gfx11-rocm-nightly-YYYYMMDD. Single multiarch binary — covers all RDNA3/3.5 targets. Linux only, no Windows binary. Runs on Linux ROCm self-hosted runner.

forks.label: llama.cpp Vulkan (upstream reference)
forks.notes: Upstream ggml-org baseline. Used as performance reference for fork comparisons.

forks.label: llama.cpp HRX (ROCm/ggml-staging-automation)
forks.notes: Experimental HRX backend. Linux gfx1151 only. Auto-discovers all 'llamacpp-hrx' models from server_models.json; add an optional model_filter to pin a subset.

forks.label: gufo (gufo-org, Strix Halo engine)
forks.prepare_cmd: mkdir -p "${GUFO_MODELS_DIR:?set GUFO_MODELS_DIR to a runner-persistent path outside the workspace}" && hf download unsloth/Qwen3.8-27B-GGUF Qwen3.8-27B-UD-Q4_K_XL.gguf --local-dir "$GUFO_MODELS_DIR/Qwen3.8-27B-GGUF"
forks.launch_cmd: ${CONTAINER_ENGINE:-podman} run --rm --name gufo --device /dev/kfd --device /dev/dri ${GPU_GROUP_FLAGS:---group-add keep-groups} --ipc=host --ulimit memlock=-1 -p 8080:8080 -v "${GUFO_MODELS_DIR:?}:/models:ro" ghcr.io/gufo-org/toolboxes/gufo-runtime:latest gufo serve --host 0.0.0.0 --port 8080 llm --model /models/Qwen3.8-27B-GGUF/Qwen3.8-27B-UD-Q4_K_XL.gguf
forks.notes: NON-llama.cpp bring-your-own backend (kind: external_openai). Open-source (MIT) C++/HIP engine for Strix Halo (gfx1151). IMPORTANT: gufo compiles model-SPECIFIC Wave32 HIP kernels and does NOT load arbitrary GGUFs — it serves only a curated roster (Qwen3.8-27B dense, Qwen3.8-Flash-Next, DeepSeek-V4, ...). This entry uses the dense Qwen3.8-27B path with a DFlash2 speculative draft (the README's canonical setup). Needs a 128GB gfx1151 box; will NOT fit 32GB. Benched via the generic external path: prepare_cmd hf-downloads the target + draft GGUF into $GUFO_MODELS_DIR (runner-persistent, outside the workspace), launch_cmd runs the container, then `lemonade bench --base-url`, then teardown. lemond bypassed => no VRAM tracking. Served model id is read live from GET /v1/models (gufo derives it from GGUF metadata, e.g. a 'Qwen3.8-27B' id; the driver resolves it). enabled:false until first bring-up confirms: (1) non-stream /v1/chat/completions returns usage.completion_tokens (gufo may only emit usage on the STREAMING path w/ stream_options.include_usage — if runs show tps=0, that's why); (2) the exact /v1/models id; (3) that --ipc=host + memlock are right. WARNING: gufo's /health and /ready return 200 even during a GPU outage (issue #278) — trust actual token output, not health. Pin :latest to an immutable tag once validated. Podman rootless needs crun + user in render/video; Docker swaps keep-groups for numeric render/video GIDs (handled by the workflow's engine detection).
